name: Address Autocomplete (with Photon API) - Geofield prepropulate
description: Submodule of Address Autocomplete (Photon) that fills a Geofield's latitude/longitude from the selected address suggestion.
project_description: Submodule of Address Autocomplete (with Photon API). Provides functionality for automatically filling Geofields on user address autocomplete selection. When a user picks a suggestion from the Photon-backed address autocomplete widget, this submodule populates a Geofield's longitude and latitude from the selected result's geometry. Requires both the parent address_autocomplete_photon module and the Geofield module.
